newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Telesis, SBC merger approved by FCC.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Telesis, SBC merger approved by FCC.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission approved the pending merger between Pacific Telesis Group and SBC Communications Inc, Pacific Telesis and SBC said on Friday.
The commission voted unanimously and unconditionally to approve the merger of the two companies, which would involve the transfer of hundreds of wireless licenses from Pacific to SBC.
A spokesman for SBC said the two companies were only waiting for a decision from the California Public Utilities Commission before going ahead with their plans to merge.
The commission was expected to announce its decision in March, he said, adding that SBC and Pacific would close their $17 billion deal "shortly thereafter."
The merger, which was announced last April, involves a stock swap, he added.
